g.text: + public; - private. Italic operations are abstract; underlined operations are static.
Solid arrow = retained reference; dashed = call or explicit ID lookup.
Shared aggregation: ComboMeal has two references (first/second) to 1..2 distinct items.
Encapsulation: Customer owns transitions/satisfaction; Order owns progress and the locked bill.
Polymorphism: Regular loss8/cycle-or-combo; VIP loss5/10%/cycle; Critic loss12/Pasta.
GameState owns the queue/tables; its relationships are in view 3.
